summary: Verified Tonight's Move Generator V2 (tag-based mood weighting). New test file /app/backend/tests/test_itinerary_v2.py with 17 tests covering: /api/admin/tags auth + canonical vocab (>=20 tags), tag backfill for seeded businesses (Hattie B's, Catbird Seat, Bluebird Cafe, Skull's Rainbow Room, Patterson House, L.A. Jackson, UP Rooftop, Bridgestone Arena all carry expected tags), relevance_score field in every step, 30-run statistical bias for 4 moods (just-vibing favors safe over nightlife/club; send-it favors wildcard/hidden_gem/unique over tourist_favorite; very-down favors nightlife/popular/concerts over quiet/scenic; down keeps date_night/cocktails/rooftop/live_music names ~30% of picks), sponsor multiplier layered on top of equal relevance (platinum>>none at 60 runs), heavy-penalty edge case (tags=[nightlife,club] under just-vibing) clamps to 0.05 floor and does not crash, no-tags business doesn't crash, slot order preserved across all 4 vibes, exclude_ids still works, POST + PATCH with tags persists and round-trips through public GET. All 17 V2 tests pass plus full 67/67 regression on prior backend suites. Frontend smoke: admin /admin -> Add Business form shows data-testid='business-form-tags' container with all 25 canonical pills (business-form-tag-{tag} testids); clicking COCKTAILS + ROOFTOP toggles them visually. /tonight?vibe=send-it returns 4 steps in correct slot order (Catbird Seat -> Attaboy -> Bluebird Cafe -> Skull's Rainbow Room — exactly the high-relevance picks for send-it). No issues found.

minor.issue: Single transient connect timeout (port 443) during a 60-run sponsor-vs-relevance loop. Retry passed cleanly. Same flake observed in iteration 4. Not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~840 lines; recommend splitting itinerary engine, admin routes, and analytics into modules. Already flagged in iteration 4.
PATCH /api/admin/businesses filters out None values but keeps empty lists, so tags=[] correctly clears — verified by test_patch_tags_empty_list.
Tag backfill is idempotent and name-keyed; if business names change in seed_data the backfill silently no-ops. Consider logging unmatched names on startup.
/api/admin/tags returns list(VALID_TAGS) which is a frozen vocab — frontend AdminDashboardPage.jsx fetches it dynamically (good).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (admin tag UI + /tonight smoke)
